# paperstamp

> Static, dependency-free browser layout designer + print runtime. Design forms, bind data, print at exact positions onto pre-printed paper. No build step, no server, no npm.

paperstamp renders a `layoutDef` (page size, orientation, positioned text items) onto a page-sized canvas and prints it at exact mm positions. It can run standalone (designer) or embedded in any host via a hidden iframe + `postMessage`.

## Live URLs (usable directly, no install)

- Designer: https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/
- Embed runtime: https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/sdk.html
- Host SDK (script): https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/sdk.js
- SDK demo: https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/example.html

`paperstamp` is published on GitHub Pages, so external projects can load the SDK
straight from the live URL — no clone, no npm, no bundler:

```html
<script src="https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/sdk.js"></script>
```

`sdk.js` auto-derives its iframe target (`sdk.html`) from its own
`<script src>`, so no `src` option is required.

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/downloaddoctor/paperstamp
- License: MIT
- Version: 1

## Minimal integration (host page)

```html
<script src="https://downloaddoctor.github.io/paperstamp/sdk.js"></script>
<script>
  const lp = PaperStamp.embed({
    origin: location.origin,
    onReady: ({ layouts }) => console.log('ready', layouts),
    onDone:  (job)       => console.log('printed', job),
    onError: (err)       => console.error(err.code, err.message)
  });

  lp.print({
    layoutDef: {
      pageWmm: 210, pageHmm: 297, orientation: 'portrait',
      items: [{
        id: 1, type: 'text', x: 10, y: 10, w: 60, h: 8,
        text: 'Name', name: 'name', fontSize: 14,
        align: 'left', valign: 'top'
      }]
    },
    fieldValues: { name: 'Jane Doe' }
  });
</script>
```

## API

`PaperStamp.embed(opts) -> instance`

opts: `src?`, `origin?`, `container?`, `width?`, `height?`, `autoShow?`,
`defaultLayout?`, `layoutId?`, `onReady?`, `onDone?`, `onError?`.

instance methods: `preview({layoutDef, fieldValues?})`,
`print({layoutDef, fieldValues?, options?})`,
`printById(layoutId, fieldValues?, options?)`,
`register(layoutDef)`, `ping()`, `isReady()`, `layouts()`, `layoutDefs()`, `listLayoutDefs(cb?)`, `previewById(id, fv?)`,
`on('ready'|'done'|'error', fn)`, `openDesigner({layoutId?, minimal?})`, `setDesignerLayout(layoutId, {minimal?})`, `closeDesigner()`,
`export(cb?)`, `import(layoutDef, options?)`, `destroy()`.

## Schemas

```ts
type Item = {
  id: number;
  type: 'text';
  x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; // 0-100, % of page
  text: string;
  name: string;        // field key used to bind fieldValues
  fontSize: number;    // pt
  align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
  valign: 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';
};

type LayoutDef = {
  name?: string;       // if set, upserted into plugin localStorage
  pageWmm: number;     // portrait width in mm
  pageHmm: number;     // portrait height in mm
  orientation: 'portrait' | 'landscape';
  items: Item[];
};
```

## Raw postMessage protocol (no SDK)

Host -> plugin: `paperstamp:preview` | `paperstamp:print` |
`paperstamp:printById` | `paperstamp:register` | `paperstamp:ping` |
`paperstamp:openDesigner` | `paperstamp:setDesignerLayout` | `paperstamp:closeDesigner` |
`paperstamp:export` | `paperstamp:import`

Plugin -> host: `paperstamp:ready {version, layouts, layoutDefs}` |
`paperstamp:layoutDefs {layouts}` (reply to listLayoutDefs) |
`paperstamp:done` | `paperstamp:error {code, message}`

Error codes: `E_BAD_ORIGIN`, `E_BAD_MESSAGE`, `E_BAD_LAYOUT_DEF`,
`E_NO_LAYOUT`, `E_PRINT_BLOCKED`.

## Notes

- Full embedding contract: https://github.com/downloaddoctor/paperstamp/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
- Browser support: Chrome, Edge, Firefox. Safari `@page` mm positioning is approximate.
- `window.print()` always shows the print dialog; true silent printing needs Chrome `--kiosk-printing` or an Electron host.
- Item text is rendered via `textContent` (no HTML injection).
- Layouts persist in the plugin origin's `localStorage` under `paperstampLayouts` (capped at 100, LRU evicted).
